job_dedupe_active_idx.name: job_dedupe_active_idx
job_dedupe_active_idx.where: dedupe_key is not null and status in ('queued', 'running')

transaction_posted_complete.name: transaction_posted_complete
transaction_posted_complete.value: "transaction"."status" <> 'posted' or ("transaction"."account_id" is not null and "transaction"."account_amount" is not null and "transaction"."base_amount" is not null)

transaction_transfer_destination.name: transaction_transfer_destination
transaction_transfer_destination.value: "transaction"."type" <> 'transfer' or "transaction"."status" <> 'posted' or ("transaction"."to_account_id" is not null and "transaction"."to_account_amount" is not null and "transaction"."to_account_id" <> "transaction"."account_id")
